decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy channel and had a stable web presence, so an expanding firm with slack has no clear shortfall prompting it to drop the range.
The skin and hair supplement fits the established OTC pharmacy business and had its own page with no reported problems, so results appear satisfactory enough to keep it.
Joint health is a steady supplement category in German pharmacies, and the product gained its own page in 2019, suggesting it meets the firm's aspirations.
The immune supplement probably benefited from higher immune-product demand during the pandemic, and the firm's slack lets it carry this niche mushroom concept.

The 2018 valsartan impurity recall was a clear shortfall, but blood pressure generics are a core volume market and a large generics firm will likely keep the product with a cleaner API source rather than exit.
The OTC triptan is a differentiated self-medication product that fits the firm's strategy of broadening its consumer health portfolio, and no problems were reported.
